scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:shrinkwrap && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.version:patch: node scripts/version-npm-packages.mjs patch && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run shrinkwrap:coding-agent
scripts.version:minor: node scripts/version-npm-packages.mjs minor && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run shrinkwrap:coding-agent
scripts.version:major: node -e "console.error(\"Mupt releases do not use major bumps; use npm run version:mupt -- <version> if needed.\"); process.exit(1)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish: npm run prepublishOnly && npm run publish:npm
scripts.publish:dry: npm run prepublishOnly && npm run publish:npm:dry
scripts.publish:npm: npm run publish:ai && npm run publish:agent && npm run publish:coding-agent
scripts.publish:npm:dry: npm run publish:ai:dry && npm run publish:agent:dry && npm run publish:coding-agent:dry
scripts.release:major: node -e "console.error(\"Mupt releases do not use major bumps.\"); process.exit(1)"
